Identified as this saint because: An icon Commons titles «Saint Paraskevi of Rome» and files under its category 'Icons of Paraskeva of Rome'. The epithet of Rome is the whole of the identification and is what this folder needs: saint.gr keeps «Αγία Παρασκευή η Οσιομάρτυς» on 26 July and doxologia.ro «Sfânta Cuvioasă Muceniță Paraschevi din Roma» on the same day, the virgin-martyr born at Rome under Antoninus — not Paraskeva of Iconium, whose day is 28 October, and not Petka of the Balkans. The sixteenth-century Damaskinos icon in the same category was the other candidate and was passed over: it paints her decapitation, which is the scene and not the woman. Commons describes it: Paraskevi of Rome
